title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 10: Fight Back

scenes.say: Therapy isn't a cure. It's a training plan.
scenes.visual: a calendar on a wall with appointments circled in red, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He learns his triggers like he learned his weapon.
scenes.visual: a notebook with handwritten notes and arrows, a pen beside it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Breathe in four. Hold four. Out four.
scenes.visual: a man sitting on a bench at sunrise, eyes closed, calm, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He starts running again. Not from something. Toward something.
scenes.visual: a man running on a city track at dawn, breath visible in the cold, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Chemo ends. The scans come back clean.
scenes.visual: a doctor's clipboard on a desk, sunlight across it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He reads the word remission ten times to make sure it's real.
scenes.visual: a man holding a medical letter, hands trembling, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Cancer took his hair, his weight, his strength.
scenes.visual: an old photo of a strong soldier beside a mirror reflection of a thin man, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a man doing push ups on a bedroom floor, sunrise through blinds, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every rep is a conversation with the man he almost became.
scenes.visual: sweat dripping onto a wooden floor, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's not surviving anymore. He's fighting back.
scenes.visual: a man standing on a rooftop at sunrise, arms at his sides, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eleven. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a pair of running shoes by a door at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 10 of 25: Fight Back. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
